ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: 5 of 6 copy ads open on fiers de nos couleurs, so one story carries the account and a skipped buyer sees nothing new. Test two or three angles from the product against that opener and keep whichever wins.

0 of 30 live ads are video, so a buyer scrolling past only sees still images. Motion shows fit and color buyers compare before they buy. Shoot three videos of the product worn and lead the next batch with them.
One exact copy runs in 5 of 6 ads, so the same words reach the same people over and over. Keep the copy body but change the opening line and the creative in each ad, using two new openers.
None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so buyers have nothing concrete to trust before tapping. Pick one number, like a review count or orders shipped, and lead your next ads with it.
